statement: ∀ (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (S : Set (Fin n → ZMod p)), Submodule.span (ZMod p) S = ⊤ ↔ ∀ f : Module.Dual (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p), f ≠ 0 → ∃ v ∈ S, f v ≠ 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0037 · 以每个非零泛函的见证刻画满生成
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0037 · Characterize generation by detecting every nonzero linear functional

brief.zh: 若生成空间真小，从商空间取非零泛函。反向在标准基上使用线性。
brief.en: For a proper span take a nonzero functional on the quotient. For the converse use linearity on the span.
